description: This Java class 'IterateSectionWidget' is part of the OFBiz widget model framework. It handles rendering of iterable sections within a web UI, supporting pagination, dynamic content expansion, and nested widget rendering.

classes.name: IterateSectionWidget
classes.description: A widget class for rendering iterable sections with pagination support within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: renderWidgetString
methods.description: Renders the widget's HTML content, iterating over a list or map, supporting pagination, and rendering nested sections.

methods.name: getPaginateTarget
methods.description: Returns the target service or URL for pagination links.

methods.name: getPaginate
methods.description: Determines whether pagination is enabled based on configuration and context.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the configured number of items per page.

methods.name: renderNextPrev
methods.description: Renders the HTML for pagination controls (next/previous links).

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing or processing the widget.
